title: Rust production RPL ingress bypasses authenticated SCHC version admission
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs authenticates a frame then discards its AuthenticatedFrame capability and passes only Vec payload onward; node.rs and routing/router.rs admit DIOs while ignoring Rule Version options. The safe lichen-rpl process_authenticated_dio API is unused in production, so absent, malformed, duplicate, or mismatched version options can mutate routing. Preserve authenticated frame evidence through production RPL ingress and require exactly one canonical type 0x13 length1 current-v3 option bound to instance, DODAG, MOP, role, and signer before any state mutation. Test root/non-root and every rejection shape.
